To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed a new method to synthesize enantiopure tetrahydropyrifines by an intramolecular hetero Diets-Alder reaction, and we showed that the sulfinimine can be transformed into a pyrrolidine or an imine, which is an important step in our synthesis of the alkaloid (+)-lupinine.

we have developed the first enantiospecific hetero Diels‐Alder reaction of a sulfinimine and an enol ether, and we have developed a new and efficient method for the synthesis of N‐substituted tetrahydropyrifines and dihydropyridinones.

we have found a new, efficient and highly selective method to synthesize tetra- and dihydropyridinones from enantiopure α-unsaturated sulfinimines and alkenes, and to remove the chiral auxiliary in a highly stereoselective way.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a new method for the synthesis of chiral pyridine derivatives by means of hetero DielsAlder reactions of enantiopure α,β -unsaturated sulfinimines with electron-deficient dienophiles.
the development of new synthetic methods and the application of these in the synthesis of natural products.
the synthesis of enantiopure α-substituted sulfinimines and the development of their application in hetero Diels‐Allder reactions for the synthesis of chiral tetrahydropyrindines and pyrrolines.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the hetero Diels‐ Alder reactions of enantiopure α‐,β‐unsaturated sulfinimines 1 with electron‐rich enol ethers lead to tetrahydropyrindines 2 with very good to excellent endo/exo and diastereoselection.

the hetero Diels‐Adder reactions of α,β‐unsaturated sulfinimines with electron‐rich enol ethers are a powerful method for the synthesis of tetrahydro- and dihydropyridinium derivatives with high stereoselectivity.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can now synthesize a wide variety of tetra- and dihydropyridinium salts by the hetero Diels‐ Alder reaction of enantiopure α-aryl-β-aryl- or -alkenylsulfinimines with enol ethers.

the hetero Diels‐ Alder reactions of enantiopure α‐substituted β‐sulfinyl α,β‐ unsaturated imines with electron‐deficient dienes lead to the corresponding endo products in very good to good yield and endo/exo ratios.
the sulfinyl group is a very useful auxiliary in asymmetric hetero Diels- Alder reactions of α,β-unsaturated sulfinimines.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the sulfinimine group can serve as a masked dienophile in the intermolecular and intramolecular hetero Diets-Alder reactions of α,β-unsaturated sulfinimines.
we have shown that the hetero-Diels-Alder reaction is a viable route to tetrahydro- and dihydropyridin-3-ones.
hetero Diels–Alder reactions of α,β-unsaturated sulfinimines with enol ethers are a useful method for the synthesis of tetrahydro- and dihydropyridin-3-ones.
